name: Dark Star Vessel
designation_status: Union operational designation; true identity and classification unknown.
narrative_significance: Concealed vessel or containment architecture at the center of the Dark Star incident and continuing strategic investigation.

quarantine_state.authority: Judicator Prime task-group safety authority, Union Marshal investigation, Sentinel technical review, and Field Court preservation orders
quarantine_state.access: No routine personnel entry; remote systems operate under isolated control and evidentiary logging.
quarantine_state.screen: Watchfire and Shieldwake maintain the immediate quarantine and defense screen while Continuance supports replenishment.
quarantine_state.containment_assessment: Observed active-material flow ceased or became segmented in mapped areas after partial Third Silence engagement, but full containment is not established.

canon_observations: Was concealed within or behind the mining-vessel profile presented as M.V. Carpathia.
Used external mining structure and sensor shaping to produce a false internal profile.
Displayed segmented internal signal and material domains of approximately thirty-seven meters in observed areas.
Contained suspended captives from multiple populations and eras, including Marshal Selene Ark.
Its hull or internal material could reshape passages, isolate signals, animate armor and bodies, and imitate observed systems.
Contained a central phenomenon operationally designated the dark star.
Reacted to the Third Silence artifact and alternating Sentinel/Ranger field frequencies.
Was boarded by the Third Measure crew, Kestrel Detachment, and Shadow Fleet personnel.

A partial Third Silence engagement briefly exposed nested internal segmentation, thousands of restraint frames, empty or inactive interface positions, and an apparent structure extending below the mapped hull.
The same engagement coincided with a massive sensor flare that exposed cloaked vessels and additional anomalous returns.
After the boarding party withdrew, the vessel drew fragments of the Carpathia shell around itself and partially reconstructed the mining-vessel presentation.
Remained in the Lethan system after the Shadow Fleet withdrew.
staging_interpretations: The vessel is definitively a prison.
The captives function as intentional containment locks, memory processors, or network nodes.
The vessel possesses a unified consciousness.
The dark star is a living entity.
The vessel was created by the Shadow Fleet.
The apparent thirty-seven-meter segmentation is globally uniform.
The partial Third Silence engagement restored safe containment.
The sensor flare was an intentional transmission.
The seventeen vectors correspond to other Dark Star vessels or receivers.
The apparent structure below the mapped hull occupies ordinary physical space.
carpathia_boundary: M.V. Carpathia is the observed mining-vessel identity and external presentation. It is not yet established whether Carpathia was an independent ship, a constructed shell, a captured vessel, or a false registry attached to the concealed architecture.
promotion_pass: Dark Star Narrative Reconciliation Pass — 2026-07-22; Third Silence Narrative Audit — 2026-07-22
